rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.

Chunk 1 line 6 'the next one' -> 'session' same sentence. Chunk 3 LOs self-contained (line 19 'the bug's ticket' <- line 16 'a trivial bug', same chunk). Chunk 6's seven links (40-52) use each linked file's own H1 as link text (verified directly: painting-the-picture-with-the-llm.md='# Painting the picture with the LLM', the-wizard-move.md='# The wizard move', orient-and-introspect.md='# Orient and *map the window*', fix-tests-first.md='# Prove the bug, then ship the fix', close-the-ticket.md='# Close the ticket *your team's way*', compound-and-close.md='# Compound and *close the loop*', the-machine-you-just-met.md='# The machine you just met') — structural include-links, not prose needing in-chunk antecedents; line 52 also fits the module-arc-beats carve-out. Not too fast, not too slow.' — the declarative comes first, the two-part hedge follows with no third payoff clause, inverse of the banned shape, stays inside.
